services.name: PatientNative
services.description: Import and process patient images, generate lead fields, and run spatial heart/circulation research models.
services.scope: Requires explicit reviewed data and parameters; no clinical qualification.

services.name: CardiAnatomy
services.description: Prepare geometry and assess simulation readiness.
services.scope: Native geometry and QC checks do not establish patient-image reconstruction accuracy.

services.name: CardiAtlas
services.scope: Retrieved citations and records require claim-level review and biological-identity reconciliation.

services.name: CardiBench
services.description: Define and inspect benchmark data contracts.
services.scope: Schema-valid datasets still need reconciled biological units, splits and appropriate endpoint labels.

services.name: CardiEval
services.scope: A working evaluator does not grant scientific validity to its submitted model or reference data.

services.name: ElectroTrace
services.scope: External algorithm characterization exists. Lead selection and new recording domains require task-specific evaluation.

services.name: MyoTrace
services.description: Extract mechanical motion from video and TIFF.
services.scope: Motion events are not independently verified cardiac beats; motion magnitude is not force without calibration.

services.name: OptiCell
services.description: Assess microscopy inputs and image quality.
services.scope: Segmentation and QC accuracy depend on imaging domain and selected backend.

services.name: CardioScore
services.scope: Complete endpoint inputs are required; the CiPA workbook audit does not qualify predictive score cutoffs.

services.name: CardiLearn
services.scope: Blocked: raw-count acquisition, baseline and model gates remain incomplete. No trained cross-study model is assumed.

services.name: CardiEP
services.scope: Numerical reference evidence exists; patient electrical predictions require registered measured validation.

services.name: CardiFlow
services.scope: 0D and rigid-pipe checks do not qualify arbitrary patient-anatomy CFD or moving-wall models.

services.name: CardiMech
services.description: Simulate lumped or restricted spatial mechanics.
services.scope: Spatial and lumped backends have different supported boundaries; patient myocardial validation remains open.

services.name: CardiInfer
services.description: Calibrate models and inspect parameter uncertainty.
services.scope: Intervals are model-conditional. Synthetic recovery does not establish calibrated patient uncertainty.

services.name: CardiSim
services.scope: Simulation output and surrogate benchmarks are not empirical patient-response evidence.

services.name: CardiSimNative
services.description: Use the built-in reference digital twin.
services.scope: A reference integration model; independent patient accuracy and full upstream equivalence remain open.

services.name: CardiTherapy
services.scope: Executable intervention scope is narrow; contract availability does not establish treatment efficacy.

services.name: CardiTrace
services.scope: Hash and journal integrity support reproducibility, not the scientific truth of a result.

services.name: CardiBridge
services.scope: Transport integrity does not establish payload science. Broker deployment qualification is separate.

services.name: CardiAgent
services.scope: Synthetic fidelity controls do not qualify patient realism, biological causality, or longitudinal behavior.

services.name: CardiVex
services.scope: Limited empirical characterization; external independent subject-level qualification remains incomplete.

services.name: CardiStudio
services.scope: Synthetic/statistical checks require empirical calibration for the intended experimental design.

services.name: DCCP
services.scope: Data readiness is distinct from empirical severity and recovery qualification.
